compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
`tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py::test_a_transient_probe_stall_is_re_sampled_rather_than_reported` failed once in a local `make verify` on 2026-10-21 PDT (lane ebf5, tree 155238156af = origin/main ca042ec0f49 plus change 3056 patch set 3): `assert int(state.read_text()) == 3` got 4 (`tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py:182`). The run was `1 failed, 19791 passed, 87 skipped` at host load average 11-16 with other lanes' suites running. Neither the test nor `tests/_isolation.py` differs from origin/main in that tree; the same code tree (patch set 2, 0e63a6d135e) passed `make verify` with 0 failures, and the test then passed 8 of 8 isolated runs (two of them took ~50 s each, the rest ~1.3 s).

The test sets `_isolation.GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 0.5` and counts git invocations through a blocking-git shim that stalls exactly one sample. Hypothesis (unproven): under host load an un-stalled sample also exceeds the 0.5 s per-attempt bound, so the guard re-samples it too and the count becomes 4. Alternatives: the shim's state counter races between invocations; the first `head()` call itself retried.

## Reproduction (2026-10-25, current main, deterministic)
Scratch copy of the test whose git shim sleeps before delegating to real git on every healthy call, simulating interpreter and git startup under load:
- delay 0 s and 0.2 s: passes (3 invocations).
- delay 0.45 s (real git adds the rest, so healthy calls land just over the 0.5 s bound): fails with exactly "git was invoked 4 times", the reported outcome.
In that failure `after == before` still held, so the guard behaved correctly: the stalled sample was re-sampled and HEAD was not reported moved. Only the `== 3` count assertion failed.

## Root cause
The shim stalls "the second `rev-parse HEAD` invocation" and the test asserts the total invocation count is 3. Both encode timing: a healthy call that exceeds the 0.5 s per-attempt bound is also retried by the guard, shifting every later count (and a slow `before` sample can even make the stall land on the wrong sample). The count is a proxy for the contract "the stalled sample was re-sampled and not reported as a moved HEAD", and the proxy breaks under host load.

## Approach
1. In `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py` add a shim variant that stalls the FIRST `rev-parse HEAD` that finds a marker file, claiming the marker with an atomic `os.unlink` so exactly one process stalls, and appends `stall` or `ok` to a log file for each probe. The test creates the marker immediately before the `after` sample.
2. Replace the `== 3` assertion with the contract: the log holds exactly one `stall`, at least one `ok` follows it, and `after == before`. Per-attempt healthy slowness no longer matters.
3. Give the test a 2 s per-attempt bound (patch `GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`) so a healthy resample has 4x headroom under load; the stall costs one timeout, about 2 s.
4. Leave `_blocking_git` and the persistent-stall tests untouched: they still prove that retry exhaustion fails explicitly.

## Scope
In scope: `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py`. Out of scope: `tests/_isolation.py` and its retry count or timeout policy.

## Testing
```
pytest tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py -q
make verify
```
Also: the same scratch delay harness (0.45 s healthy delay) against the NEW test must pass, and a seeded variant whose guard has `GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS = 1` must make the new test fail (no resample means a timeout is raised), so the test still detects a broken retry. Failure case: the old test fails at the 0.45 s delay.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The new test passes with healthy git calls delayed to 0.45 s and 0.9 s, where the old assertion failed at 0.45 s (checked: scratch delay runs recorded in a ticket comment).
- [x] The new test fails when the guard does not re-sample (`GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS = 1`) (checked: seeded run).
- [x] The persistent-stall tests are unchanged and pass (checked: `pytest tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py -q`).
- [x] `make verify` is green on the Linux CI gate (`Verified +1` on the Gerrit change).
